correctness.rationale: Containment of the chain order makes every BML modal preorder total. Mutual-accessibility classes are forced to be contiguous by transitivity, and every contiguous block partition conversely defines a valid modal preorder. This gives the 2^(n-1) census. The exact relation identity d R e iff ell(d)<=e then reduces the published bounded-modal successor condition to one suffix. An exhaustive checker through n=6 verifies the equivalence relation, count, ell recurrence, and semantic domains.

value.rationale: Finite chains model linearly nested scope structures, a central configuration in the staging motivation of BML. The result gives a complete natural classification, exact count, and linear-size representation of the modal component, and reduces every bounded-modal successor domain to a single suffix threshold. This is a reusable structural normal form for finite BML experimentation rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
